Overview

Lumina Lumière Institute needed a platform where members sign in, follow programs and watch lessons. I built it in Next.js and owned the project from first setup through launch, then handed it over for ongoing maintenance.

The challenge

A course platform is several products at once: a content structure (programs → lessons → video), an account system for members, a marketing site that has to be found, and the email and tracking that turn visitors into students. All of it had to ship together and stay easy to deploy.

Approach

  1. Structure the learning content

    Modelled programs and lessons with video as structured content.

  2. Member accounts

    Built member accounts for the membership side of the platform.

  3. Automate delivery

    Set up automated Vercel deployments so every change ships the same way.

  4. Connect the funnel

    Integrated MailerLite automations for email, plus GA4 and Meta Pixel tracking for measurement.

  5. Be findable — by search and by AI

    Implemented SEO and AEO/GEO optimisation so the platform is discoverable in classic search and in AI-generated answers.
